title: Bee Removal in Throgs Neck, Bronx
metaDescription: Professional wasp, hornet, yellow jacket, and carpenter bee removal in Throgs Neck, Bronx. Nest treatment, removal, and entry-point sealing. Call (855) 930-5016.
intro: Throgs Neck residents facing wasp nests, hornet colonies, yellow jacket ground burrows, or carpenter bee damage need fast, effective treatment that addresses both the nest and the entry points. Our licensed technicians treat and remove active nests from wall voids, soffits, attics, eaves, and wood structures throughout this peninsular Bronx community. Every service includes nest treatment, removal of accessible material, and sealing to prevent recolonization.
whyUs: Best Pest Control NYC combines over 15 years of experience with eco-friendly bee removal techniques tailored to Throgs Neck's unique mix of single-family homes, waterfront properties, and apartment buildings. Our licensed technicians arrive quickly, assess your situation thoroughly, and remove colonies safely while offering prevention advice specific to your property type.
localContext: Throgs Neck's proximity to the Long Island Sound and abundance of gardens around Fort Schuyler and the Throgs Neck Bridge area create ideal conditions for wasp and hornet nesting activity, especially during spring and summer months. The neighborhood's many Tudor-style homes, brick colonials, and older structures often provide sheltered spaces where yellow jackets, paper wasps, and bald-faced hornets establish nests in eaves, chimneys, soffits, and wall voids — locations that require structural access and complete sealing after treatment.

faqs.question: Do you treat honeybees in Throgs Neck?
faqs.answer: No, we do not treat honeybees. If an inspection confirms a colony is honeybees rather than wasps or hornets, we refer the situation to a licensed beekeeper instead of treating it ourselves.

faqs.question: Can wasps or hornets return after nest removal in Throgs Neck?
faqs.answer: Once we treat and remove a nest, that colony will not return. Every service includes sealing the nest entry points to prevent new colonies from recolonizing the same void. Every service includes a service agreement — terms depend on the service and are confirmed on the call.
